title: Hudson River Exhibition Call for Entries
content: A national juried landscape exhibition called “The Great Hudson River Exhibition” is open for entries in all media including painting, drawing, printmaking, photography, sculpture, and mixed media.Here’s more information:Host organization:Mill Street LoftExhibition venue: Riverside Arts in BeaconJuror:Bartholomew Bland,Curator of theHudson River Museumin Yonkers, NY.Entry deadline: May 31, 2011Entry fee: $30 for first four images, $5.00 for each additional. Electronic or CD submission.Exhibition dates: July 9-Sept. 3, 2011.Opening reception: July 9, 4-8 pmPDF of entry formFacebook pageImage above by William Trost Richards
